snippet.title: MSX Game: Rally-X (1984 Namco)
snippet.description:
You control a small car running around in a maze. What you have to is to pick up the ten flags to get more points. While you try to collect the flags you are chased by hostile cars that try to crash your car.

Please like this video and subscribe to my channel for more great retro content.
